searchText: The "non-legacy" forks are fully covered already. I mean e.g. SSTORE test case 0 → X → 0. I mostly would need to enable some existing tests for some legacy forks like Frontier. It can be generated if you make expect section for those forks in new tests. Then you can PR a new test file in legacy tests. The format might changed a little.
